name: Startups Lab

sources.title: Startups Lab — live weekly launch platform; 'Submit your product… no algorithms, no manual review, no waiting'; free listing ('Get my free listing', no credit card), weekly Monday batches, permanent product pages, Top-3 community vote earns a DR-56 dofollow backlink; paid plans guarantee dofollow day one + placement; spotlight slots $29/30d; advertising from $59/30d

requirements: Free submission — name, URL, description, screenshots ('5 minutes or less'); no credit card
Weekly launch cycle — batches publish every Monday 00:00 UTC; submit before Sunday midnight
Free launches are 'scheduled automatically'; paid plans pick a specific date or boosted placement
Permanent product page at /product/<slug> for every listing
Dofollow backlink: guaranteed on paid plans; free listings earn it by finishing Top 3 in the weekly vote
Extras: spotlight slots $29/30 days, in-feed advertising from $59/30 days
preparation: Plan for upvotes — community voting determines Top 3 and the free dofollow backlink
workflow: Click 'Get my free listing'/'Submit product' -> submit form
Product joins the next Monday batch (or a chosen slot on paid plans)
Drive votes during launch week; Top 3 earns the dofollow backlink and badges
Product page persists permanently after launch week
watchFor: Young independent directory — '2,000+ founders', '877 products', DR 56 are site-reported; treat as a small launch venue
Free dofollow is conditional on Top-3 finish — otherwise the free link is presumably nofollow
Paid placement options are prominent (spotlight, ads, premium scheduling)
countsAsLive: The product has a permanent page at startupslab.site/product/<slug>
unknowns: Paid plan pricing detail beyond spotlight/ad slots
